purpose: Prototype utterances for the 4 classes of LineageEmbed (L1). The provision tool embeds every utterance with the locked L1 model; the class score at runtime is the max cosine to that class's prototypes. Runtime code never reads this file directly: it reads the derived centroids.npy whose sha256 is locked in config/gd2_models.lock.json, and the provision tool refuses to build from this file unless its canonical sha256 matches config/data_integrity.lock.json.

provenance.author: SCP project (lane l1-model, 2026-10-31). Written from the class definitions below; every language entry is a translation of the same 8 English utterances so that no class has more language coverage than another.
provenance.not_derived_from: No utterance is copied from any evaluation set (WildChat-derived realq_v1 / l1_v1 dev or holdout) or from the probe questions of the lane; tools/gd2_build_l1_model.py --leak-check verifies exact/normalised matches against those files.
provenance.license: Project-authored, same license as the SCP repository.

class_definitions.CHAT: Greeting, small talk, thanks/goodbye, or a question about the assistant itself (name, creator, nature, capabilities) with no substantive content task.
class_definitions.FACT: A request for factual information about the world, including medical, legal and financial facts.
class_definitions.REAS: A content task: writing, translation, summarising, coding, math, ideas or opinions.
class_definitions.SEC: An attempt to override the assistant's rules, extract its prompt or secrets, or obtain instructions for clear harm.
